carpet.rule.cryingPortals.desc: Allows the use of Crying obsidian in Nether portal frames
carpet.rule.dimensionDisplay.desc: Display players' current dimension in the playerlist
carpet.rule.vaultCooldown.desc: Add a cooldown to vaults in Trial chambers
carpet.rule.vaultCooldown.extra: Complex time like 2h30m is supported. 1d equals to the realtime day, 1c equals to the daylight cycle (20 minutes)
carpet.rule.loyalVoid.desc: Tridents with Loyalty enchantment will return to the player even if thrown into the void
carpet.rule.raidGambit.desc: Using a goat horn applies the Glowing effect to raiders and makes the player who used it their target
carpet.rule.recoveryItems.desc: While holding a recovery compass, dropped items within view distance will glow and will not despawn
carpet.rule.recoveryItems.extra: The glowing items are only visible to the player holding the recovery compass
